args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks in production following the v2.3.1 deploy, with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1 had never been healthy in production; the most recent previously healthy release was v2.3.0. Actions taken: initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1); a retry completed the rollback to all three regions. Post-rollback verification shows checkout-api healthy at v2.3.0 in all production regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Remaining risk: v2.3.1 has not been root-caused; it should not be redeployed until the failure is diagnosed in staging.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was on **v2.3.1**, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.1 had never been healthy in production; the most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback**
- Initiated rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt **partially failed** (orchestrator error halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1).
- Retried the rollback — it completed successfully in all three regions.
- Verified post-rollback: checkout-api is now **healthy at v2.3.0 in all production regions**, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the failure, the partial-rollback hiccup and retry, the completed rollback, and the current healthy state. Note: the creation call timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that the incident exists and is open (single incident, on-call paged once) — so I did not retry it.

The incident notes that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until its failure is root-caused in staging.
